INSTITUT FERRAND — CONFIDENTIEL\nObjet ::
FERRAND INSTITUTE — CONFIDENTIAL
Subject: identification and priority transfer of asymptomatic carriers.

1. Any exposed patient (confirmed bite) who develops no symptoms within 72 hours is classified as a “carrier”.
2. Carriers constitute the strategic resource of the vaccine programme. Their transfer to Ferrand Island takes priority over any other evacuation.
3. The carrier’s consent is sought. It is not required.
